==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am playing a VR game where I have to fight a flying elemental. The elemental can change their element at will. In order to defeat them, I have to stun lock them with a barrage of ice attacks while they're not using fire.

After I defeat the elemental in the game, I discover a mysterious camera outside of the game. I pick up the camera and start taking pictures of toys. Suddenly the camera starts glitching out and playing a video.

On the video, I see a weird creature resembling a bee fused with a humanoid spider. The creature says their name is Reclusix and that they're trying to take over the multiverse. My girlfriend wakes me up, before I can learn more and stop Reclusix.
